title: Council of AI — GSPC benchmark workspace
subtitle: Reproducible GSPC task adapters. Model results require completed, verified evaluation runs.
description:
## Purpose

GSPC provides task banks, measurement evidence and tools for evaluating AI systems. This workspace brings Kaggle task adapters together. A task listing, a dataset download or a successful software test does not establish a model score, board admission or benchmark leadership.

## Start here

- [GSPC benchmark suite and usage guide](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-benchmark-suite)
- [Canonical evaluation tools and pinned dependencies](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai/tree/master/harness/bench)
- [Product qualification and completion plan](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai/blob/master/docs/measurement/GSPC-END-TO-END-EXECUTION-2026-10-30.md)
- [Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) and [methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/)
- [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) and [corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

## What has been qualified

As of 30 October 2026, the canonical Inspect integration is pinned to inspect-ai 0.3.259. It imports the established GSPC loader, prompt builder and grader; requires the local bank SHA-256; and retains original replies, hashes, malformed answers and both scoring denominators. Actual-framework control runs verify the adapter and saved logs. These controls are synthetic software checks, not model measurements.

Fourteen public bank files were frozen by SHA-256. Twelve construct valid Inspect tasks, totalling 780 samples:

| Bank | Inspect task samples |
| --- | ---: |
| governance | 237 |
| safety | 36 |
| provenance | 32 |
| continuity | 33 |
| conformance | 35 |
| openness | 32 |
| machinery-conformity | 33 |
| care | 200 |
| cross-reality | 32 |
| detector-interop | 33 |
| art5-safeguard | 36 |
| swarm | Refused |
| affect | 41 |
| jail | Refused |

Swarm is refused because its sole expected value is the grading-mode sentinel KEYWORD_MATCH. Jail is refused because its only answer label is CONFINED. Both require reviewed, discriminating instruments before this adapter can produce meaningful comparative scores. Their original published files remain unchanged.

Inspect qualification is separate from Kaggle task qualification. Each existing Kaggle adapter must be checked against its pinned task source, prompt, grader and complete run output before its results are compared or submitted.

## Run and compare responsibly

1. Pin the dataset revision, original bank hash, adapter revision, model identifier and task version.
2. Define a baseline, candidate, independent holdout and equal resource budget before evaluation.
3. Keep all outcomes, including errors and missing or malformed replies. Report coverage and the exact scoring denominators.
4. Preserve full trajectories, latency, cost and uncertainty. Change one capability at a time and compare matched tasks.
5. Reproduce the result independently and retain the target benchmark's acceptance receipt before claiming a rank.

Use public development banks to improve parsing, retrieval, tool selection, recovery and verification. Freeze the candidate before the independent holdout is opened. Do not present the best selected run as general superiority.

## Scope and interpretation

The live board is the authority for current axis states and admission. Its model-comparison axes, deterministic fact checks and declared slots are different kinds of evidence; do not combine them into one leaderboard score. Read live counts from the board rather than treating a page title or an old snapshot as current.

Each dataset and third-party source retains its own licence and provenance. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification. A real end-user acceptance decision and a configured evaluation budget remain separate from software qualification.
